title: Lesson 1: Food & Restaurant Conversations
description: Learn to pronounce food-related vocabulary and practice ordering in restaurants with confidence.

quizzes.title: Food Vocabulary Flashcard
quizzes.instruction: Review these essential food and restaurant vocabulary words. Pay attention to the pronunciation and try to remember their meanings.

front.contextSentence: We ordered an appetizer while waiting for the main course.

back.mainDefinition: A small dish of food served before the main meal to stimulate the appetite.
back.mainDefinitionTrans: Món ăn nhỏ phục vụ trước bữa ăn chính để kích thích vị giác.
back.example: The restaurant's fried calamari appetizer is delicious.

detailedDefinitions.example: Could we see the appetizer menu, please?

front.contextSentence: Fresh ingredients are the secret to this dish.

back.mainDefinition: The different foods that are combined to make a particular dish.
back.mainDefinitionTrans: Các loại thực phẩm khác nhau được kết hợp để tạo thành một món ăn cụ thể.
back.example: Could you list the ingredients in this salad?

detailedDefinitions.example: The main ingredients are chicken, garlic, and herbs.

front.contextSentence: Would you like a beverage while you look at the menu?

back.mainDefinitionTrans: Đồ uống bất kỳ loại nào.
back.example: The beverage menu includes both alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks.

detailedDefinitions.example: All beverages are included in the price.

front.contextSentence: Italian cuisine is known for pasta and pizza.

back.mainDefinition: A style or method of cooking, especially as characteristic of a particular country, region, or establishment.
back.mainDefinitionTrans: Một phong cách hoặc phương pháp nấu ăn, đặc biệt là đặc trưng của một quốc gia, khu vực hoặc cơ sở cụ thể.
back.example: This restaurant specializes in French cuisine.

detailedDefinitions.trans: Ẩm thực, phong cách nấu ăn
detailedDefinitions.example: Vietnamese cuisine is famous for its fresh ingredients.

front.contextSentence: We made a reservation for 7 PM.

back.mainDefinition: An arrangement whereby something, especially a seat or room, is booked in advance.
back.mainDefinitionTrans: Sự sắp xếp để một thứ gì đó, đặc biệt là chỗ ngồi hoặc phòng, được đặt trước.
back.example: Do you have a reservation under your name?

detailedDefinitions.example: I'd like to make a reservation for two people.

front.contextSentence: The restaurant offers several vegetarian options.

back.mainDefinition: A person who does not eat meat or fish, and sometimes other animal products, especially for moral, religious, or health reasons.
back.mainDefinitionTrans: Một người không ăn thịt hoặc cá, và đôi khi các sản phẩm động vật khác, đặc biệt vì lý do đạo đức, tôn giáo hoặc sức khỏe.
back.example: I'm a vegetarian, so I don't eat meat.

detailedDefinitions.example: Are there any vegetarian dishes on the menu?

back.mainDefinition: The sweet course eaten at the end of a meal.
back.mainDefinitionTrans: Món ngọt được ăn vào cuối bữa ăn.
back.example: Chocolate cake is my favorite dessert.

front.contextSentence: The steak entrée comes with vegetables.

back.mainDefinition: The main course of a meal.
back.example: For my entrée, I'll have the grilled salmon.

detailedDefinitions.example: The entrées are listed on the second page of the menu.

front.contextSentence: Could we have the check, please?

back.example: We asked for the check after finishing our meal.

detailedDefinitions.example: Is service included in the check?

front.contextSentence: We left a 15% tip for our server.

back.mainDefinition: A small amount of money given to someone for performing a service; a gratuity.
back.mainDefinitionTrans: Một khoản tiền nhỏ được đưa cho ai đó để thực hiện một dịch vụ; tiền boa.
back.example: It's customary to leave a tip for good service.

detailedDefinitions.example: How much should I leave as a tip?

quizzes.title: Pronunciation Drill: Food Vocabulary
quizzes.instruction: Practice pronouncing these common food and restaurant terms correctly. Focus on syllable stress and vowel sounds.

quizzes.title: Dictation: Restaurant Phrases
quizzes.instruction: Listen to the audio and type exactly what you hear. These are common restaurant phrases.

dictations.text: Could we <gap id='g1'>see</gap> the <gap id='g2'>menu</gap>, please?
dictations.translate: Chúng tôi có thể xem thực đơn được không?

dictations.text: I'll <gap id='g3'>have</gap> the <gap id='g4'>chicken</gap> with <gap id='g5'>vegetables</gap>.
dictations.translate: Tôi sẽ gọi món gà với rau củ.

dictations.text: Is this <gap id='g6'>dish</gap> <gap id='g7'>suitable</gap> for <gap id='g8'>vegetarians</gap>?
dictations.translate: Món này có phù hợp cho người ăn chay không?

dictations.text: We <gap id='g9'>made</gap> a <gap id='g10'>reservation</gap> for <gap id='g11'>seven</gap> o'clock.
dictations.translate: Chúng tôi đã đặt bàn lúc bảy giờ.
dictations.ipa: /wiː meɪd ə ˌrez.əˈveɪ.ʃən fɔːr ˈsev.ən əˈklɒk/

dictations.translate: Hôm nay bạn gợi ý món gì?

dictations.text: Could I <gap id='g14'>have</gap> some <gap id='g15'>more</gap> <gap id='g16'>water</gap>, please?

dictations.text: Could we have <gap id='g19'>separate</gap> <gap id='g20'>checks</gap>, please?
dictations.translate: Chúng tôi có thể thanh toán riêng được không?

dictations.text: I'd <gap id='g21'>like</gap> to <gap id='g22'>try</gap> the <gap id='g23'>house</gap> special.
dictations.translate: Tôi muốn thử món đặc biệt của nhà hàng.
dictations.ipa: /aɪd laɪk tuː traɪ ðə haʊs ˈspeʃ.əl/

dictations.translate: Mọi thứ đều ngon, cảm ơn bạn!

quizzes.title: Error Correction: Restaurant English
quizzes.instruction: Identify and correct the grammatical error in each restaurant-related sentence.

errorCorrections.question:
I

would like

order the pasta.
errorCorrections.explain:
Correct: I would like to order the pasta.
Dịch: Tôi muốn gọi món mì ống.
Giải thích: Sau 'would like' cần có 'to' + động từ nguyên thể.

errorCorrections.question:
Could we

makes

a reservation?
errorCorrections.explain:
Correct: Could we make a reservation?
Dịch: Chúng tôi có thể đặt bàn được không?
Giải thích: Sau 'could' dùng động từ nguyên thể 'make'.

errorCorrections.question:
She

don't

eat meat.
errorCorrections.explain:
Correct: She doesn't eat meat.
Dịch: Cô ấy không ăn thịt.
Giải thích: Với chủ ngữ 'she' dùng 'doesn't' thay vì 'don't'.

errorCorrections.question:
We are

interesting

in the daily special.
errorCorrections.explain:
Correct: We are interested in the daily special.
Dịch: Chúng tôi quan tâm đến món đặc biệt hàng ngày.
Giải thích: 'Interested' dùng để diễn tả cảm giác, 'interesting' dùng để mô tả sự vật.

errorCorrections.question:
How much

cost

this dish?
errorCorrections.explain:
Correct: How much does this dish cost?
Dịch: Món này giá bao nhiêu?
Giải thích: Câu hỏi với 'how much' cần có trợ động từ 'does' cho chủ ngữ số ít.

errorCorrections.question:
I have

allergic

to nuts.
errorCorrections.explain:
Correct: I have an allergy to nuts. / I am allergic to nuts.
Dịch: Tôi bị dị ứng với hạt.
Giải thích: 'Have' + danh từ (allergy) hoặc 'am' + tính từ (allergic).

errorCorrections.question:
Could you

bringing

us some bread?
errorCorrections.explain:
Correct: Could you bring us some bread?
Dịch: Bạn có thể mang cho chúng tôi ít bánh mì được không?
Giải thích: Sau 'could you' dùng động từ nguyên thể.

errorCorrections.question:
The food was

amazingly

good.
errorCorrections.explain:
Correct: The food was amazing.
Dịch: Thức ăn thật tuyệt vời.
Giải thích: 'Amazing' là tính từ bổ nghĩa cho 'food', 'amazingly' là trạng từ.

errorCorrections.question:
We would like

sit

near the window.
errorCorrections.explain:
Correct: We would like to sit near the window.
Dịch: Chúng tôi muốn ngồi gần cửa sổ.
Giải thích: Sau 'would like' cần 'to' + động từ nguyên thể.

errorCorrections.question:
This is

more better

than I expected.
errorCorrections.explain:
Correct: This is much better than I expected.
Dịch: Cái này tốt hơn nhiều so với tôi mong đợi.
Giải thích: 'Better' đã là so sánh hơn, không cần 'more'. Dùng 'much' để nhấn mạnh.

quizzes.title: Multiple Choice: Restaurant Situations
quizzes.instruction: Choose the most appropriate response for each restaurant situation.

questions.question: When you arrive at a restaurant and want to be seated, you say:
options: Do you have a table available?
questions.answer: Do you have a table available?
questions.explain: This is the polite way to ask for a table at a restaurant.

questions.question: The server asks: 'How would you like your steak cooked?' Your response:
questions.explain: 'Medium rare' is a standard way to describe how you want your steak cooked.

questions.question: You want to ask for the bill. You say:
options: Could we have the check, please?
questions.answer: Could we have the check, please?
questions.explain: This is the polite way to ask for the bill in a restaurant.

questions.question: The server asks: 'Is everything okay with your meal?' You're enjoying it. You say:
questions.explain: This is a positive and polite response when you're enjoying your meal.

questions.question: You need to get the server's attention. You say:
questions.explain: 'Excuse me' is the polite way to get someone's attention in English.

questions.question: You want to make a reservation. You say:
options: I want to eat here tomorrow
Save me a table for Friday
I'd like to make a reservation for two, please
Can I come here on Saturday?
questions.answer: I'd like to make a reservation for two, please
questions.explain: This is the standard polite way to make a restaurant reservation.

questions.question: You're allergic to seafood. When ordering, you say:
questions.explain: This clearly communicates a medical dietary restriction to the server.

questions.question: You want to know what's in a dish. You ask:
options: Could you tell me what's in this dish?
What are the things in here?
questions.answer: Could you tell me what's in this dish?
questions.explain: This is a polite way to ask about ingredients.

questions.question: You've finished eating and want to leave. You say:
options: Thank you, we're ready to go
questions.answer: Thank you, we're ready to go
questions.explain: This is a polite way to indicate you're finished and would like to leave.

questions.question: The food arrives but it's not what you ordered. You say:
options: Excuse me, I think this is the wrong order
questions.answer: Excuse me, I think this is the wrong order
questions.explain: This is a polite way to address a mistake with your order.

quizzes.title: Gap Fill: Restaurant Conversation
quizzes.instruction: Fill in the blanks with the correct words to complete the restaurant conversation.
quizzes.question:
Server: Good evening! Do you have a ?
Customer: Yes, under Smith, for two people.
Server: Right this way. Here are your .
Customer: Thank you. Could we start with some ?
Server: Of course. Would you like still or sparkling water?
Customer: Sparkling, please. And could you tell us about the daily ?
Server: Today's special is grilled salmon with lemon butter .
Customer: That sounds good. I'll have that. How is the salmon ?
Server: Medium rare is recommended. And for your ?
Customer: I'll have the vegetarian pasta, please.
Server: Excellent choices. Would you like anything to ?
Customer: Just water for now, thank you.
Server: Very well. I'll be right back with your .
...
Server: How was everything?
Customer: Everything was , thank you.

answers.explain: 'Reservation' means a booking made in advance.
'Menus' are the lists of food and drinks available.
Customers often start with drinks while looking at the menu.
'Daily special' means a dish that's only available today.
'Sauce' is a liquid served with food to add flavor.
'How is it cooked?' asks about the cooking method/doneness.
'Entrée' or 'main course' is the main dish of the meal.
'Would you like anything to drink?' is a common question.
Complimenting the food when it was good.

quizzes.title: Sentence Builder: Restaurant Phrases
quizzes.instruction: Arrange the words in the correct order to form grammatically correct restaurant sentences.

builders.hint: Câu hỏi lịch sự với 'Could we have...'

Is this dish suitable for vegetarians? (Món này có phù hợp cho người ăn chay không?)

builders.hint: I'd like to try + danh từ
builders.explain: I'd like to try the house special. (Tôi muốn thử món đặc biệt của nhà hàng.)

quizzes.title: Scripted Chat: Fine Dining Experience
quizzes.instruction: Read this sample conversation at a fine dining restaurant.

chats.name: Michael
chats.content: Good evening, and welcome to Le Jardin. Do you have a reservation this evening?
chats.translate: Chào buổi tối và chào mừng đến với Le Jardin. Quý khách có đặt bàn tối nay không?
chats.ipa: /ɡʊd ˈiːv.nɪŋ, ænd ˈwel.kəm tuː lə ʒɑːrˈdæ̃. duː juː hæv ə ˌrez.əˈveɪ.ʃən ðɪs ˈiːv.nɪŋ?/
tips: Notice the formal tone and pronunciation of the French restaurant name.

chats.name: Sarah
chats.content: Yes, we do. The reservation is under Johnson, for two.
chats.translate: Vâng, chúng tôi có. Đặt bàn dưới tên Johnson, cho hai người.
chats.ipa: /jes, wiː duː. ðə ˌrez.əˈveɪ.ʃən ɪz ˈʌn.dər ˈdʒɒn.sən, fɔːr tuː./
tips: Short, clear responses are polite in formal settings.

chats.name: Michael
chats.content: Ah yes, Mr. Johnson. Right this way, please. Your table is by the window with a lovely view of the garden.
chats.translate: À vâng, ông Johnson. Mời đi lối này. Bàn của quý khách ở cạnh cửa sổ với tầm nhìn ra khu vườn.
chats.ipa: /ɑː jes, ˈmɪstər ˈdʒɒn.sən. raɪt ðɪs weɪ, pliːz. jɔːr ˈteɪ.bəl ɪz baɪ ðə ˈwɪn.dəʊ wɪð ə ˈlʌv.li vjuː əv ðə ˈɡɑː.dən/
tips: Formal titles like 'Mr.' are often used in fine dining establishments.

chats.name: Claude
chats.content: Good evening. I'm Claude, your sommelier this evening. May I offer you our wine list while you peruse the menu?
chats.translate: Chào buổi tối. Tôi là Claude, chuyên gia rượu của quý khách tối nay. Tôi có thể mang cho quý khách danh sách rượu trong khi xem thực đơn không?
chats.ipa: /ɡʊd ˈiːv.nɪŋ. aɪm klɔːd, jɔːr ˈsɒm.əl.i.eɪ ðɪs ˈiːv.nɪŋ. meɪ aɪ ˈɒf.ər juː aʊər waɪn lɪst waɪl juː pəˈruːz ðə ˈmen.juː?/
tips: A sommelier is a wine expert. 'Peruse' is a formal word meaning 'read carefully'.

chats.name: Sarah
chats.content: That would be lovely, thank you. Could you recommend a white wine to pair with seafood?
chats.translate: Thật tuyệt, cảm ơn bạn. Bạn có thể gợi ý một loại rượu vang trắng để kết hợp với hải sản không?
chats.ipa: /ðæt wʊd biː ˈlʌv.li, θæŋk juː. kʊd juː ˌrek.əˈmend ə waɪt waɪn tuː peər wɪð ˈsiː.fuːd?/
tips: 'Pair with' means to combine food and drink that complement each other.

chats.name: Claude
chats.content: Certainly. For your seafood dishes, I would recommend our Sancerre from the Loire Valley. It has crisp acidity and citrus notes that complement shellfish beautifully.
chats.translate: Chắc chắn rồi. Với các món hải sản, tôi đề xuất rượu Sancerre của chúng tôi từ thung lũng Loire. Nó có độ axit sắc và hương cam quýt bổ trợ tuyệt vời cho hải sản có vỏ.
chats.ipa: /ˈsɜː.tən.li. fɔːr jɔːr ˈsiː.fuːd ˈdɪʃ.ɪz, aɪ wʊd ˌrek.əˈmend aʊər ˈsɑ̃ː.sɛr frɒm ðə lwɑːr ˈvæl.i. ɪt hæz krɪsp əˈsɪd.ə.ti ænd ˈsɪt.rəs nəʊts ðæt ˈkɒm.plɪ.ment ˈʃel.fɪʃ ˈbjuː.tɪ.fəl.i/
tips: Wine terminology includes words like 'crisp acidity' and 'notes' (flavors).

chats.name: Isabelle
chats.content: Good evening. My name is Isabelle and I'll be your server this evening. Are you ready to order, or would you like more time with the menu?
chats.translate: Chào buổi tối. Tên tôi là Isabelle và tôi sẽ là người phục vụ của quý khách tối nay. Quý khách đã sẵn sàng gọi món chưa, hay cần thêm thời gian xem thực đơn?
chats.ipa: /ɡʊd ˈiːv.nɪŋ. maɪ neɪm ɪz ˌɪz.əˈbel ænd aɪl biː jɔːr ˈsɜː.vər ðɪs ˈiːv.nɪŋ. ɑːr juː ˈred.i tuː ˈɔː.dər, ɔːr wʊd juː laɪk mɔːr taɪm wɪð ðə ˈmen.juː?/
tips: Fine dining servers often give their names and ask if you need more time.

chats.name: David
chats.content: I believe we're ready. I'll start with the foie gras terrine, followed by the Dover sole meunière. And for my wife, the heirloom tomato salad and the lobster thermidor.
chats.translate: Tôi nghĩ chúng tôi đã sẵn sàng. Tôi sẽ bắt đầu với gan ngỗng terrine, sau đó là cá bơn Dover meunière. Còn vợ tôi, salad cà chua heirloom và tôm hùm thermidor.
chats.ipa: /aɪ bɪˈliːv wɪər ˈred.i. aɪl stɑːrt wɪð ðə fwɑː ɡrɑː teˈriːn, ˈfɒl.əʊd baɪ ðə ˈdəʊ.vər səʊl mənˈjeə. ænd fɔːr maɪ waɪf, ðə ˈeə.luːm təˈmɑː.təʊ ˈsæl.əd ænd ðə ˈlɒb.stər ˈθɜː.mɪ.dɔːr/
tips: Formal dining often uses French culinary terms. Notice the precise ordering language.

chats.name: Isabelle
chats.content: Excellent choices. And how would you like the sole prepared? We recommend it with brown butter and capers.
chats.translate: Lựa chọn tuyệt vời. Và quý khách muốn cá bơn được chế biến thế nào? Chúng tôi đề xuất với bơ nâu và quả bạch hoa.
chats.ipa: /ˈek.sə.lənt ˈtʃɔɪ.sɪz. ænd haʊ wʊd juː laɪk ðə səʊl prɪˈpeəd? wiː ˌrek.əˈmend ɪt wɪð braʊn ˈbʌt.ər ænd ˈkeɪ.pəz/
tips: Servers often confirm cooking preferences for certain dishes.

chats.name: David
chats.content: That sounds perfect. And could you ensure my wife's lobster is prepared without any dairy? She has a lactose intolerance.
chats.translate: Nghe thật hoàn hảo. Và bạn có thể đảm bảo tôm hùm của vợ tôi được chế biến không có sữa không? Cô ấy không dung nạp lactose.
chats.ipa: /ðæt saʊndz ˈpɜː.fɪkt. ænd kʊd juː ɪnˈʃɔːr maɪ waɪfs ˈlɒb.stər ɪz prɪˈpeəd wɪˈðaʊt ˈeni ˈdeə.ri? ʃiː hæz ə ˈlæk.təʊs ɪnˈtɒl.ər.əns/
tips: Formal way to communicate dietary restrictions: 'ensure... without any...'

chats.name: Isabelle
chats.content: Absolutely, sir. I'll inform the chef immediately. Your appetizers will be out shortly.
chats.translate: Chắc chắn rồi, thưa ông. Tôi sẽ thông báo với bếp trưởng ngay lập tức. Món khai vị của quý khách sẽ ra ngay.
chats.ipa: /ˈæb.sə.luːt.li, sɜːr. aɪl ɪnˈfɔːm ðə ʃef ɪˈmiː.di.ət.li. jɔːr ˈæp.ə.taɪ.zəz wɪl biː aʊt ˈʃɔːt.li/
tips: 'Absolutely' is a strong affirmative. 'Sir' shows respect in formal service.

chats.name: Isabelle
chats.content: Was everything to your satisfaction this evening?
chats.translate: Mọi thứ có vừa ý quý khách tối nay không?
chats.ipa: /wəz ˈev.ri.θɪŋ tuː jɔːr ˌsæt.ɪsˈfæk.ʃən ðɪs ˈiːv.nɪŋ?/
tips: Formal way to ask if the meal was good.

chats.name: Sarah
chats.content: Everything was exquisite. Please compliment the chef on our behalf.
chats.translate: Mọi thứ đều tuyệt hảo. Làm ơn chuyển lời khen của chúng tôi đến bếp trưởng.
chats.ipa: /ˈev.ri.θɪŋ wəz ɪkˈskwɪ.zɪt. pliːz ˈkɒm.plɪ.ment ðə ʃef ɒn aʊər bɪˈhɑːf/
tips: 'Exquisite' is a strong compliment meaning extremely beautiful or delicate.

chats.name: Isabelle
chats.content: I certainly will. It was our pleasure to serve you this evening. We hope to see you again soon.
chats.translate: Chắc chắn tôi sẽ làm vậy. Thật vinh hạnh được phục vụ quý khách tối nay. Chúng tôi hy vọng sẽ sớm gặp lại quý khách.
chats.ipa: /aɪ ˈsɜː.tən.li wɪl. ɪt wəz aʊər ˈpleʒ.ər tuː sɜːv juː ðɪs ˈiːv.nɪŋ. wiː həʊp tuː siː juː əˈɡen suːn/
tips: Formal closing statement in fine dining establishments.
